observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white projector with a lens on the left and a small button on the right. The brand name is not clearly visible.
Photo 1: Top view of the projector. The brand 'Panasonic' is clearly visible, along with the model 'PT-VW355N' and 'WXGA'. There are control buttons and a warning label.
Photo 2: Rear view of the projector showing various ports (VGA, HDMI, USB, etc.), the brand 'Panasonic', and the model 'PT-VW355N' on the label. A serial number and regulatory marks are also visible.
All photos show the projector on a wooden floor with a Jiji watermark.

claims.evidence: The model PT-VW355N is known to have 4,000 lumens, but this cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The seller's text is not verifiable from the images.
This specification is not visible on the device or in the photos. It is a claim from the seller's text.
No visual evidence of dynamic iris feature. This is a seller claim not visible in photos.
Photo 1 and photo 2 show 'WXGA' which corresponds to 1280x800 resolution. The model PT-VW355N is known to have native WXGA resolution.

risks.risk: Projector may not be functional or may have lamp issues
risks.proof: A video showing the projector turning on, projecting an image, and displaying full brightness and color.

risks.risk: Lamp life may be exhausted or near end-of-life
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the lamp hours counter or a clear indication of lamp status.
A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the projector.

proof_requests: Video of the projector turning on and projecting a clear image.
Photo of the lamp hours counter or lamp status.
Photo of all included accessories (remote, cables, power cord).
response.reason: The projector is identifiable as a Panasonic PT-VW355N from clear text on the top and rear. The resolution claim is supported by the WXGA label. Other specifications are unverifiable but not critical for pricing at worst case. Hidden risks like functionality and lamp life are noted, but the item can be priced at its worst case (non-working, missing accessories) until proven otherwise.
